description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat from step 2.
